QuestInfo.name: We Need Meat
QuestInfo.0: #bSophia#k in Twilight Perion has a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: The laborers around Twilight Perion aren't getting #renough food#k. Procure 25 #bGiant Porkchops#k from #rPillaging Wild Boars#k and #rPillaging Iron Hogs#k.
QuestInfo.2: You hunted down #rPillaging Wild Boars#k and #rPillaging Iron Hogs#k and delivered 25 #bGiant Porkchops#k.

0.0: Sorry, traveler, but I don't really have much in the way of hospitality. We barely have enough food for ourselves.
0.1: Our... glorious leaders keep us working night and day, and we #rnever get enough to eat#k. I guess it's better than rotting in the ground...
0.2: Say, since they don't have you working, would you mind getting some food? I bet those #rPillaging Wild Boars#k and #rPillaging Iron Hogs#k have some nice, meaty #bGiant Porkchops#k.

yes.0: Everyone will be so happy! Could you get those #b25 Giant Porkchops#k, please?

no.0: This is your chance to save lives...

1.0: Did you get them all? The #b25 Giant Porkchops#k?

yes.0: Everybody's looking so much stronger with some food in their bellies!

item.0: We need #b25 Giant Porkchops#k to eat well. You said you'd help!
